results.title: Impasse
results.overview: A street artist surviving through art fraud discovers, for the first time, what it truly means to leave an authentic mark — after crossing paths with a mysterious painter.

results.title: The Cut
results.overview: A retired boxer intends to return to the ring for one last shot at the title, but first he must make the weight. Holed up in a room in Las Vegas with an unscrupulous trainer, he embarks on an intensive and illegal weight-cutting program.

results.title: Tin Soldiers
results.overview: Falling behind in class, a parent-teacher conference sends Caius down a pharmaceutical rabbit hole that impacts him for the rest of his life. As he grows, Caius must navigate the complexities of mental health treatment at a time when he's still discovering what 'normal' is.

results.title: My Omaha
results.overview: After graduating from journalism school, Nick Beaulieu returns to his hometown of Omaha, Nebraska to document its surging racial justice movement while seeking to reconnect with his staunchly pro-Trump father Randy - a task made more urgent when Randy is unexpectedly diagnosed with stage-4 cancer.

results.title: Sirai
results.overview: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.

results.title: The Trial
results.overview: In 2035, a new law holds parents responsible for their children’s crimes. Set in the United Kingdom, Dione and David Sinclair are thrust into a nightmarish legal battle when their teenage daughter, Teah, commits a serious crime.

results.title: Nilavuku En Mel Ennadi Kobam
results.overview: Prabhu, a young chef, is ready to move forward with an arranged marriage when his past love, Nila, unexpectedly reenters his life, challenging his plans and emotions.

results.title: Wish You Were Here
results.overview: After a whirlwind romance ends with him disappearing, a woman discovers that her brief love interest is terminally ill and helps him make the most of his remaining days.

results.title: Reflejo
results.overview: When Inés finds out she has three days to fit into a dress that isn't her size, she makes extreme decisions to make it happen.

results.title: The Spy
results.overview: To infiltrate the enemy, British intelligence orchestrates a false escape and a deadly betrayal. This piece is also a spin-off from the feature length movie War Blade.

results.title: Trainwreck: The Cult of American Apparel
results.original_title: Trainwreck: The Cult of American Apparel
results.overview: Featuring tell-all interviews with insiders and former staff, this exposé traces American Apparel's journey from fashion phenomenon to financial flop.

results.title: Wicked: One Wonderful Night
results.overview: Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande lead a one-time-only, two-hour special featuring electrifying performances alongside their Wicked: For Good co-stars for a night of reimagined musical arrangements, cast interviews, behind-the-scenes moments, exclusive surprises, and a sneak peek at Wicked: For Good.

results.title: Minor Chronicle
results.overview: In a town south of Mexico City, the director relives the moment his father fell ill during the second wave of the coronavirus.

results.title: Stripper Moms
results.overview: When a suburban housewife finds out her husband is cheating, she returns to her roots as a stripper in order to win him back.

results.title: Flood
results.overview: In communist Czechoslovakia in 1980, 15-year-old Mara dreams of leaving her village to study in the city and become a pilot. But her father, a widowed Ruthenian farmer, insists she stay and work the land. When her village faces destruction due to a new dam, their generational conflict intensifies, revealing the struggle between tradition, identity, and the desire for freedom in a context of historical change.

results.title: In the Fever of the Dawn
results.overview: At a New Year's Eve party, four friends steal a crate of beer and decide to head to Mosqueiro to see the first sunrise of the year. While trying to stay sane throughout the journey, they go through crazy adventures that test their friendship.

results.title: Dark Secret
results.overview: When a couple takes in a new roommate, long-buried truths begin to fester, inciting a chilling game of manipulation and survival.

results.title: Calle Malaga
results.overview: An aging Spanish woman in Tangier resists her daughter's plan to sell her home. She fights to keep her home, reclaims belongings and rediscovers love and desire.

results.title: Bill Burr: Drop Dead Years
results.overview: In what might be his most personal and introspective hour yet, Bill offers hilarious takes on everything from male sadness to dating advice.

results.title: Nuestros Planes
results.overview: A woman going through emotional grief takes a trip to the beach in search of inner peace.
